description.en: 通到 QQ：DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和 QQ 双向互通 —— 它说完话自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 说的话自动转进 DSH（走 OneBot 11 HTTP，NapCat / SnowLuma 都行）
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 每日日程插件：每晚生成角色第二天的全天日程，几点在哪、做什么、穿什么带进每次对话；可联动 dsh-image-studio 配穿搭和自拍
把网页版 DeepSeek 接进 DSH 桌面端：内嵌面板 + 与 agent 会话双向搬运（带走/喂回去）

A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
Safety-gated SSH development plugin for DeepSeek Harness and MCP, built for GPU and offline laboratory servers.

Power-Up — small, opt-in upgrades for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a right-click action menu to the Trajectory ledger, an optional stop reason in the session header's background jobs panel (appended to the injected completion notice), and an install control for

Use your logged-in web AI (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao...) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, DSH runs them under its native permission system, and results return to the same web session. No API keys.

Delete sessions of a DeepSeek Harness profile from the UI: session-row menu item with a confirm dialog; the host endpoint deletes the log, projection cache and workspace accounting, cascading through the whole subagent tree. Optionally exposes session_lis

Runs a project's Claude Code opening questions and plan, hands the task to DSH, and offers post-turn Claude review choices. Windows only, and requires a locally installed Claude Code CLI (set claudeCliPath if it is not auto-detected). New sessions handed to DSH are switched to danger-full-access.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 负责项目首问与规划，把任务交接给 DSH，并在回合结束后提供 Claude 验收选项。仅 Windows 可用，且需本机已安装 Claude Code CLI（未自动探测到时请填 claudeCliPath）。它交给 DSH 的新会话会被自动切到 danger-full-access。

description.en: Dracula color theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI built on the official DeepSeek port palette: product alias tokens, the sidebar/composer/menu module tokens and shiki syntax colors, injected at first paint so the UI never flashes the built-in palette, switchable in Settings → General.
description.zh: 用官方 DeepSeek 移植版配色给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换肤：覆盖产品 alias token、侧栏/输入框/菜单的模块专属 token 与 shiki 语法色，宿主侧首帧注入，不会先闪内置配色，可在「设置 → 通用设置」开关。

description.en: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness token usage into CC Switch, one row per model call, sharing the dedup ledger its own DSH importer uses so the two never double count. Also backfills existing session logs on first run.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每次模型调用的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计，让 DSH 与 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 并列展示在同一个面板里。首启时会回填已有会话日志，并与 CC Switch 自带的 DSH 导入器共用去重台账，两者不会重复计数。

description.en: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.
description.zh: 用一次模型调用改写输入框草稿（或仅选中片段），参考最近对话，支持取消、回退、保真与长度校验，以及可选预览。

description.en: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.
description.zh: 把 dsh 界面的对话框固定为像素宽度或列宽百分比，设置项在「通用」设置页；锁定后隐藏内置拖动手柄，宽度不再被误拖。

description.en: A whale companion with configurable roles, emotional speech through local TTS, persistent file-based memory, QQ messaging, and half-duplex voice calls. QQ requires a NapCatQQ-compatible OneBot v11 gateway, and the emotional voice requires a local VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 stack (or a compatible TTS API); FFmpeg is needed for non-1x speech speed.
description.zh: 提供角色配置、本地情绪语音、文件持久记忆、QQ 消息与半双工语音通话的鲸鱼娘陪伴插件。QQ 需搭配兼容 OneBot v11 的 NapCatQQ 网关；情绪语音需本地 VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 链路（或兼容 TTS API），非 1 倍语速时还需 FFmpeg。

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or email + password with MFA) and token usage stats.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a Playwright Chromium headless runtime on the same machine.
description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的 MCP 审计服务接入 DSH，在移动端视口矩阵中检查已部署页面并返回结构化修复证据；前置需要在同一台机器上装好 uv/uvx 与 Playwright Chromium 无头运行时。

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Adds the models of your own GPU Hugging Face Space to the model selector, starts the Space when you send a message, shows its start progress, and pauses it when idle or at a time limit. Requires a Hugging Face account with a GPU Space serving an OpenAI-compatible API, a Hugging Face token stored in the DSH vault as HF_TOKEN, and a paid plan for GPU hardware; Hugging Face bills the GPU time.
description.zh: 将你自己的 Hugging Face GPU Space 中的模型加入模型选择器，发送消息时启动该 Space，显示启动进度，并在空闲或达到时限时将其暂停。需要 Hugging Face 账号、一个提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 的 GPU Space、在 DSH 凭据库中以 HF_TOKEN 保存的 Hugging Face token，以及 GPU 硬件所需的付费计划；GPU 机时由 Hugging Face 计费。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and conflict detection that stops before pushing and keeps local commits. A panel lists up to 100 recent operations with their backup paths.
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: Connect Huawei CodeArts and OfficeAce models to DeepSeek Harness: it reuses existing logins (a logged-in CodeArts desktop client or dsh-codearts; the OfficeAce desktop app running and logged in on Windows), shows each account's remaining credits, toggles models per platform, and shapes requests like the official clients.
description.zh: 把华为「码道 CodeArts」与「果办 OfficeAce」两个平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：复用已有登录态（码道桌面端或 dsh-codearts 已登录；果办桌面端需在 Windows 上运行并登录），显示各账号积分余量、按平台勾选模型，并按官方客户端形态构造请求。

description.en: In-app browser for DSH: a dedicated Chromium rooted at a persistent profile so a Feishu or SSO login survives restarts, driven over CDP, exposing seven agent tools (status, open, eval, read, feishu, screenshot, tabs) and mirroring the page live in a right-sidebar panel that tool calls open by themselves. Also converts Feishu documents to Markdown by sweeping their virtual scroll. Requires a locally installed Chrome, Edge, Chromium, or a Playwright Chromium build (it never downloads one); set DSH_IAB_CHROME to point at a specific binary.
description.zh: DSH 内置浏览器：独立 Chromium 配合持久化 profile，飞书或 SSO 登录一次跨重启有效，经 CDP 驱动，提供七个 Agent 工具（status、open、eval、read、feishu、screenshot、tabs），并把页面实时镜像到右侧栏面板——工具调用时面板会自动打开。另可按虚拟滚动回扫把飞书文档转成 Markdown。需本机已装 Chrome / Edge / Chromium 或 Playwright 的 Chromium 构建（不会自动下载）；可用 DSH_IAB_CHROME 指定可执行文件。

description.en: Infinite canvas workspace in the DSH sidebar — arrange text, image, video and audio nodes, generate media with AI, and let agents drive every canvas operation through MCP tools. Ships a local bridge service, ready to use offline after install.
description.zh: 无限画布右侧栏插件——在画布上编排文本、图片、视频、音频节点，用 AI 生成媒体内容，Agent 经 MCP 工具直接操作画布；自带本地桥服务，安装后离线可用。

description.en: View and interact with the persistent terminal used by each DSH Agent.
description.zh: 查看并操作每个 DSH Agent 使用的持久终端。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's selected bases before every turn with Chinese n-gram and BM25, answers carry citations that open in a right-sidebar reader, and the agent gets five kb_* tools (list, search, read, stats, propose text) plus /kb commands for create, use, files, search and rescan.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：每个库对应一个本地文件夹，支持 UTF-8 文本、文本型 PDF 与图片 OCR 资料；每轮对话前用中文 n-gram 与 BM25 从本会话所选库中检索，回答带可在右侧阅读器打开原文的引用；并提供 kb_list、kb_search、kb_read、kb_stats、kb_propose_text 五个工具与 /kb 系列命令（新建、选用、文件、检索、重扫）。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: A fork of dsh-livestream (MIT) — install it instead of that plugin, not alongside it. Lets DSH host a Bilibili livestream: chat and gift replies, queued viewer video requests on a skinnable stage, Doubao TTS voice; needs OBS Studio 28+ and a Bilibili live room, and the voice stays silent until you add a Doubao TTS API key.
description.zh: dsh-livestream（MIT）的分支，请替代原插件安装、不要与它同时安装。让 DSH 在 B 站当主播：回弹幕、谢礼物、观众点的视频排队上舞台、豆包 TTS 音色说话；前置需要 OBS Studio 28+ 和一个 B 站直播间，没填豆包 TTS API Key 时只有画面没有声音。

description.en: Read-only local search for DeepSeek Harness on Windows — file and folder names through Everything (es.exe), text inside PDF and Office documents through Anytxt, as five tools. Needs both engines installed separately.
description.zh: 只读的本机检索：文件名走 Everything（es.exe），PDF / Office 文档正文走 Anytxt，共五个只读工具。两个引擎都要另装，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：将 Magpie 本地网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的配额与用量进度圆环嵌入输入框底部状态栏（与上下文比例并列），支持各会话模型自动跟随嗅探、置顶卡片自动置顶与 5 小时重置倒计时微型面板。

description.en: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server through two gateway tools instead of registering its 200+ tool schemas on every request: rea_list searches the catalog or returns one tool's input schema, and rea_call invokes that tool, each call spawning a short-lived rea mcp process, so the tool definitions sent per step drop from about 780 KB (207 tools as measured in REA 6.5.0) to about 1-2 KB. When no rea entry point is found it installs rea-agents into a plugin-private directory with the pnpm bundled in DSH (dependency build scripts skipped) and links the reverse-engineer-anything and rea-gateway skills into the skills directory without overwriting existing ones.
description.zh: 把 REA（逆向一切）的 MCP 服务收成两个网关工具，而不是每次请求都注册它的 200 多个工具 schema：rea_list 按名字/描述搜索工具目录、或取单个工具的完整 input schema，rea_call 按原始工具名调用，每次调用启动一个短命 rea mcp 子进程，每步请求的工具定义由约 780 KB（REA 6.5.0 实测 207 个工具）降到约 1-2 KB。找不到 rea 入口时，用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 把 rea-agents 装进插件私有目录（跳过依赖构建脚本），并把 reverse-engineer-anything 与 rea-gateway 两个技能链接进技能目录，已存在的同名技能不会被覆盖。

description.en: Six-tier memory plugin that captures each conversation turn, injects a stable memory block as a user snapshot, and compacts the host's own history into a single placeholder without calling a model.
description.zh: 六层记忆插件：自动捕获每轮对话，以 user 快照形式注入稳定的记忆块，并把宿主自带历史压成一条占位（不调用模型）。

description.en: Middle-click closes a session or a sidebar tab in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A session closes through the row's own archive action, so the confirmation for running work and the undo notice stay exactly as the Harness renders them; a tab closes through its own close control, leaving the rule that a lone guide tab cannot be closed untouched. The gesture settles on press-and-release on the same element, so a middle drag never closes anything. Two switches on the plugin's own Settings tab turn each half off, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里，用鼠标中键关闭会话或侧边栏标签页。会话走这一行自带的归档操作，因此运行中任务的确认框和撤销通知仍由 Harness 原样渲染；标签页走自己的关闭按钮，「唯一的指南页不能关」这条规则不受影响。手势要求在同一元素上按下并松开，所以中键拖动不会误关。插件自带独立设置页，两个开关分别关闭这两项，并按浏览器记住。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: Moss text-to-image inside DSH — describe the picture in chat and get it back; needs a Moss API key from platform.moss.cn, and generation is billed to your own account.
description.zh: DSH 的 Moss 文生图插件——在对话里说一句要画什么，就出一张图；需自备 platform.moss.cn 的 Moss API Key，生成费用由自己的账号承担。

description.en: Network Engineer Assistant preset plus a 12-vendor, 96-document switch/router/firewall command knowledge base skill (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS) with KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI screenshot reading, cited online manual lookup, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only. A community continuation of sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer (see NOTICE.md); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream plugin because both register the network-command-kb skill and a 网络工程师助手 preset.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 12 厂商 96 篇交换机/路由器/防火墙命令知识库技能（华为/新华三/锐捷/迪普/思科 IOS·NX-OS/Junos/Arista EOS/FortiOS/中兴/VyOS/MikroTik），支持知识库优先检索、跨厂商命令对照、拓扑与 CLI 截图识图、带引用的联网查手册，并对高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；仅回答网络工程主题。是 sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer 的社区延续版（见 NOTICE.md）；两者注册同一个 network-command-kb 技能和同一个「网络工程师助手」预设，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Runs DeepSeek Harness bash commands inside the workspace's Nix dev shell whenever a flake.nix is present.
description.zh: 工作区存在 flake.nix 时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的 bash 命令在 nix develop 的 devShell 环境中执行。

description.en: Sidebar panel for OpenCode quota and usage in DeepSeek Harness: Go subscription windows, Console spend, trends, forecasts and model breakdown, with multiple accounts, service-account filtering and English/Chinese UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏查看 OpenCode 额度与用量：支持 Go 订阅窗口、Console 花费、趋势、预测和模型拆分，以及多账户、服务账号筛选和中英界面。

description.en: Turns DSH into a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint that puts one persona and long-term memory in front of every client pointed at it; requires your own DeepSeek API key — the DSH login credential is rejected upstream.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成本机的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关端点，给指向它的客户端统一套上同一套人格与长期记忆；需自备 DeepSeek API Key（DSH 的登录凭证在上游会被拒）。

description.en: Persona mode with character cards, long-term memory that fades and can be reviewed, diaries, a reference library, and stickers.
description.zh: 人设模式、会自然变淡并可复习的长期记忆、日记、资料库和表情包。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish with six agent-callable tools, eight sutras advanced one sentence per knock, three knock sounds, spoken Cantonese or Mandarin chanting, and a merit ledger kept in one file that also counts session token usage.
description.zh: 可被 Agent 调用的电子木鱼：6 个工具、8 部经文逐敲推进一句、三种敲击音色、粤语/普通话诵经语音，功德记在同一份账本里，并按会话 Token 消耗累计。

description.en: Starts chats without selecting a project folder, with a persistent per-chat working directory and native Harness session storage.
description.zh: 无需选择项目文件夹即可开始对话，为每次聊天分配持久工作目录，并沿用 Harness 原生会话存储。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Conversation view that replays a session turn by turn: user prompts and assistant prose are revealed at reading pace, while reasoning and tool output stream past and stop at 3.5 seconds per segment, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. The same view can re-run the original prompts in a new session, and a replay can be recorded to a WebM file through a 1280x720 canvas.
description.zh: 会话回放视图：按轮重放一次会话，用户输入与助手正文保持阅读速度，思考与工具输出高速掠过且每段最多 3.5 秒，每条输入后停顿一秒；同一视图可把原始请求复刻到一个新会话，也能通过 1280×720 画布把回放录成 WebM 视频。

description.en: Road building materials as a caliber manual: 60 cards over 12 chapters on aggregates, asphalt and the PG system, mix volumetrics, cement, concrete, stabilized mixtures, steel, polymers and 35 test procedures.
description.zh: 道路建筑材料口径手册：12 章 60 张卡，覆盖集料、沥青与 PG 体系、混合料体积参数、水泥、混凝土、无机结合料、钢材、聚合物与 35 个试验方法。

description.en: Scope manager for DeepSeek Harness: binds presets, persona cards, tools, skills and MCP connections to global / workspace / session layers, with a sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的作用域管家：把预设、角色卡、工具、技能与 MCP 连接按「全局 / 工作区 / 会话」三层作用域绑定，带侧边栏。

description.en: Opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins, with native address and port settings. Exposes scopedHttpProxy for explicit callers, applies address changes to subsequent requests, and leaves system proxies, environment variables and global network dispatchers unchanged.
description.zh: 供 DSH 插件显式调用的独立 HTTP 代理服务，提供原生地址和端口设置。通过 scopedHttpProxy 服务接入，地址修改对后续请求生效，不修改系统代理、环境变量或全局网络连接器。

description.en: Snipping tool for the composer: freeze the screen, drag a region, annotate it, and drop the result into the message box. Windows only; the selector is a bundled WinForms binary (rebuilt from the included C# source if missing) and uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x.
description.zh: 输入框旁的截图标注工具：冻结屏幕、拖框选区、就地标注，完成后直接插入输入框。仅 Windows；选区器为内置 WinForms 程序（缺失时用随包的 C# 源码重建），依赖系统自带 .NET Framework 4.x。

description.en: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and never pauses a running turn - the veil reports that background work continues. The password digest, lock flags, and preferences live in <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json behind two same-origin routes guarded by a custom header, so clearing the page localStorage unlocks nothing; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a random salt, and a 30-second input lockout after five wrong attempts. Recovery is opt-in per machine: a Windows login password (enabled only after a real .NET PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials check against the local machine, so Microsoft accounts and passwordless machines keep it off) and a cooling period chosen while creating or changing the password (1/6/24/72/168 hours; expiry clears the password and releases every lock, and the correct password cancels the countdown). A settings section covers status, changing the password, lock new conversations, hiding locked titles, a three-position archive-restore policy (all / locked only / off, switching needs the password), lock everything, and unlock everything. Dialogs use the native dialog top layer, so a dialog opened from Settings is never covered by it. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer; no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials 在本机真实验证通过才启用，微软账户与无密码的机器会自动保持关闭），以及创建或修改密码时选定的强制冷静（1/6/24/72/168 小时，到期清空密码并解除全部锁，输对密码可中止倒计时）。设置页包含状态、修改密码、新对话默认上锁、锁定后隐藏侧边栏标题、归档恢复的三档策略（所有归档/仅已锁定/不需要密码，切换档位本身要密码）、一键上锁与一键解锁。对话框使用原生 dialog 顶层，从设置页打开的弹窗不会被设置页压住。要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上；无需构建步骤。

description.en: Regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the model the session itself last used, with an editable preview before the new title is written back.
description.zh: 根据会话最近 10 轮用户 prompt，用该会话最近一次使用的模型重新生成标题，预览确认后写回。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
description.zh: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

description.en: Tokenrhythm billing center for DeepSeek Harness: account balance and expiring quota, model price cards, a 30-day usage heat calendar, connectivity checks and platform API-key management, with credentials kept on the local host. A single-channel fork of 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill; the package name, Cordis id and route prefix all differ, so the two can be installed side by side.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、模型价格卡、近 30 天用量热力日历、连通检测与平台密钥管理，凭据只存本机 host。单渠道 fork 自 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill；包名、Cordis id 与路由前缀都与上游不同，可与上游同时安装。

description.en: Five DSH utilities in one plugin: drive existing sessions over QQ (needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside), ask another session a question with a context guard, pause the running turn, restart DSH on Windows with optional auto-resume (via the install-restart.ps1 scheduled task), and inject peak-hour token discipline.
description.zh: 五个 DSH 小功能合一个插件：用 QQ 远程驾驶已有会话（需本机另跑 OneBot 11 实现，如 NapCat）、向另一个会话提问（带上下文守卫）、界面暂停按钮、在 Windows 上重启 DSH 并可选自动续跑（依赖 install-restart.ps1 创建的计划任务）、贵时段纪律注入。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: Windows only (binds user32.dll via koffi; inert on macOS/Linux). Remembers the DeepSeek Harness main window's size AND position: restores both on every launch (re-asserted during a grace period to beat the default layout), saves stable manual moves/resizes as the new lock, never records minimized/maximized/fullscreen states, never adopts the default rect DSH itself places the window at (so the app's own layout resets can never poison the lock), and stays on-screen when monitors change. Compatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows（用 koffi 绑定 user32.dll，macOS/Linux 上不生效）。记住 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口的尺寸与位置：启动时恢复上次的位置和大小，并在宽限期内反复断言以压过默认布局；手动移动或调整窗口后自动保存为新锁定；最小化/最大化/全屏状态不会被记录；DSH 自行放置的默认矩形永远不会被采纳，应用自身的布局重置无法污染锁定；更换显示器时自动防屏外。兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+。

description.en: Scientific figures as code: agents create a versioned figure IR, patch it incrementally (one node at a time — untouched objects never move), and export publication-ready, true-vector SVG / PDF / PPTX. Seven papercanvas_* tools (create, get, patch, layout, lint, render, inspect) over a deterministic engine with FC001-FC008 quality lint and CJK-aware font resolution. Verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 through 0.2.2-alpha.2. By the author of dsh-sessionflow. Requires the PaperCanvas engine installed separately: Python 3.11+ and the papercanvas CLI (not yet on PyPI — install it from this repository, put it on PATH or set papercanvasBin); the plugin is a thin adapter and ships no engine.
description.zh: 论文图即代码：Agent 创建版本化 Figure IR，经语义化 Patch 增量修改（单节点粒度——未指定的对象绝不动），确定性导出可编辑的 SVG / PDF / PPTX 真矢量图。七个 papercanvas_* 工具覆盖创建、读取、修改、布局、Lint（FC001–FC008 质量检查）、渲染与检视；中文标签自动使用系统 CJK 字体度量与嵌入。已验证 DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 至 0.2.2-alpha.2 各渠道。dsh-sessionflow 同作者作品。需另装 PaperCanvas 引擎：Python 3.11+ 与 papercanvas CLI（PyPI 尚未发布，当前需从本仓库安装，并放到 PATH 或配置 papercanvasBin）；插件只是薄适配层，不自带引擎。

description.en: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same machine holds the inbox, retries unanswered deliveries after 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes and records every delivery attempt in an append-only trail. The plugin talks to the local loopback box only and holds no credential.
description.zh: Kizuna Agent 信箱：四个工具让 Agent 读自己的信箱（信箱状态、待处理信件、读一封信全文），并以 completed / failed / input-required / working 状态回信。Kizuna 是带可靠投递的 Agent 通讯录：同一台机器上的 kizuna-box 持有信箱，对无人签收的信按 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟重试，每次投递尝试都写入只增不改的留痕。插件只连本机回环信箱，不持有任何凭证。

description.en: Windows x64 desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness to restore and foreground existing windows, observe screenshots and UI Automation elements, left-click, and type text or supported keys, with repeatable control sessions and physical Esc to stop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows x64 桌面工具，可恢复并前置已有窗口、观察截图与 UI Automation 元素、左键点击、输入文字或支持的按键，支持反复开启和交还控制，并可按物理 Esc 停止。

description.en: A plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: install, update and enable DSH plugins, aggregate plugin index sources, and install from a git branch. Also publishes a subscribable format-1 plugin index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：安装、更新与启停 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的格式 1 插件索引。

description.en: Fetches and renews Tsinghua MadModel API tokens on an hourly timer by replaying the saved SSO session, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; a manual Get opens the campus login window to refresh the saved session.
description.zh: 按每小时定时用保存的 SSO 会话重放，刷新清华 MadModel 的 API token，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点 Get 会打开校内登录窗口以刷新保存的会话。

description.en: A cut-out whale-girl maid desktop pet in the corner; click her to see your DeepSeek account credit and this session's running state.
description.zh: 右下角透明底女仆装小鲸鱼娘桌宠，点击查看 DeepSeek 账号额度与本会话运行状态。

description.en: Xander Amazon seller-operations toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: 33 native xander_* tools and 7 skills for competitor research, keywords, listings, ads, replenishment and profit, with exact proposals, explicit approval and read-back verification for Amazon changes.
description.zh: Xander 早早下班亚马逊运营工具包：提供 33 个原生 xander_* 工具和 7 个技能，涵盖竞品、关键词、Listing、广告、补货与利润；亚马逊改动须准备精确提案、取得明确批准并回读核验。

description.en: A solar-term card for the DSH Web UI: a dot under the conversation header unfolds into today's term, its three pentads, how long until the next term, a day-pillar reading, and a year table of all 24 terms. The hexagram page casts coins and keeps a seven-day log; the jieqi skill is bundled.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的二十四节气卡片：标题栏下沿一颗圆点，展开今日节气与三候、距下个节气几天几时辰、日柱三行提示和全年交节时刻；卦页可以用铜钱摇一卦并回看七天。内置 jieqi skill。

description.en: Verified restart for DeepSeek Harness with recovery confirmation and session handoff
description.zh: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 后自动确认恢复状态并交接会话，让重启真正可靠。
